summary: Mesoblast filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX press release dated October 16, 2026, reporting preliminary first fiscal quarter 2026 results. Net revenue from Ryoncil sales rose 44% to US$28 million versus US$19 million a year earlier, and net operating cash spend improved 85% to US$2.3 million from US$14.9 million. The company cited US$99 million in cash as of September 30, 2026, and 54 onboarded sites. This is a routine earnings/cash update with no transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation; no deal terms apply. Watch commercialization and cash runway.
